item.title: Bessent warns unstable yen could lead to higher U.S. interest rates
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Friday disclosed a letter justifying last month's coordinated market intervention by the United States and Japan to prop up the yen.

item.title: Number of missing in Nepal, China floods soars past 2,400
item.description: Rescuers in Nepal and China were struggling Saturday to locate thousands of people missing days after a deadly, tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayan region.

item.title: Trump says U.S. has entered deal with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
item.description: President Donald Trump on Friday said the U.S. has entered an agreement with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of the South American country's oil reserves.

item.title: Man City overrun Palace to stay perfect in the Premier League
item.description: Rayan Cherki scored two goals in five minutes and Erling Haaland also got a brace as Manchester City won at Crystal Palace 4-1.

item.title: Rei Sakamoto earns U.S. Open spot, but beats his retiring hero Kei Nishikori to do it
item.description: Rei Sakamoto played his way into the U.S. Open — but only by taking the spot that Kei Nishikori, Japan's greatest men's tennis star, hoped to earn.
